depiction.primary_object: desktop computer monitor or TV screen on a short stand
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a cutout at top-right containing a downward arrow

readings.meaning: install or download desktop application / software
save or download file to computer
remote desktop incoming connection or import to PC

ambiguity: Can be confused with a generic download icon, an inbox/tray icon, or a picture-in-picture/minimize window icon at small sizes.

modifier_semantics.meaning: download, install, save locally, or import onto the device

task_intents: install operating system or driver update
set up apps on new workstation

reasoning: The icon clearly shows a computer monitor with an incoming downward arrow, universally understood as downloading to a computer or installing desktop software. It fits common digital tasks like installing programs, updating drivers, or saving files locally, while being more specific than a generic download tray icon.
